title: Storey Architecture expertise
description: A huge two-line heading with a short paragraph far to the right, then numbered rows divided by grey hairlines: a medium title, a paragraph in the right half, a ghost numeral 15vw tall in pale grey at the bottom-left and a small 5:3 photo at the bottom of the right half. On desktop each row, as it leaves, sinks and darkens while the next row slides over it. On phones the number sits beside the title and the rows simply stack.
notes: the stacking (sink 10vw + 40% veil while leaving) is desktop only, as on the original
the veil is bg-foreground: it darkens rows on light themes and pales them on dark ones
images: empty shows a bg-muted placeholder (2:1 on phones, 5:3 on desktop)
